review_notes: I read the whole file. It defines a natural isomorphism between extension of scalars and symmetric powers in ModuleCat, plus its naturality and identity-law lemmas. A Mathlib search for symmetricPower/SymmetricPower found only Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/TensorPower/Symmetric.lean. That file is about symmetric tensors, a different concept, and has no ModuleCat symmetric-power functor or extension-of-scalars comparison. The file builds on Mathlib's ModuleCat.extendScalars and extendScalarsId and does not reimplement them. It reuses Mathlib's SymmetricAlgebra, TensorProduct and the existing TauCeti base-change equivalence instead of defining a competing version. I found no competing duplicate under this rubric. I did not search every Mathlib file for other possible overlaps, so some uncertainty remains.
